caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical glass bottle placed upright at the center of a cream-colored background. The bottle is colored in shades of blue-green and has a thick neck with a rounded, pronounced lip. The word "SARATOGA" is embossed in capital letters along the upper part of the bottle's shoulder. The shading and highlights on the glass indicate reflections and transparency, showing the bottle's circular base and the thickness of the glass. The overall composition is simple, with the bottle framed by a rectangular line border. The artist's signature, "JOHN FISK," appears in small, capital letters at the lower right corner within the border.
title: Blown Glass - Bottle
